title: Merenre II
summary: Penultimate king of Egypt's Dynasty 6 according to Manetho; husband of Nitocris.
description: Penultimate king of Egypt's Dynasty 6 according to Manetho; husband of Nitocris. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "D. The Death of Merenre II is Synchronized with the Death of Concharis of D13"
death.note: Counted 12 years (Nitocris's reign in Africanus) before her death at Anchor Point #16: "Merenre II died 12 years earlier in 1491 BC". Synchronised with the death of Concharis (AP-51).

free_source_links.locator: "D. The Death of Merenre II is Synchronized with the Death of Concharis of D13"
